name: Wand-Enhancer
description: Advanced UX and interoperability extension for Wand (WeMod) app
one_liner: An unofficial add-on that improves the interface and adds extra features to the Wand (WeMod) game-cheat and trainer app.
buyer: Honestly, mostly hobbyist gamers who already use Wand/WeMod for single-player game trainers — there isn't a real paying business buyer here.
business_use_cases: A gaming community Discord could bundle setup help for members, but it's donation-driven, not a business.
A streamer showcases enhanced trainer features in content, but that's audience-building, not a product sale.

money_ideas.idea: Accept community donations for maintaining the extension.

steal_this: This isn't a business opportunity — it's a hobbyist interoperability patch for someone else's app, and reselling anything built on it risks that app's own terms of service.
